jobs.title: People Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Stuut is transforming how B2B companies turn revenue into cash. Businesses worldwide have trillions tied up in receivables, yet the work between order and payment still relies on fragmented systems and labor-intensive manual processes. Stuut’s AI agent works across order management, credit, collections, payments, cash application, disputes and deductions, carrying context through every step. Customers reduce DSO by 47%, collect 40% more cash and eliminate 70% of manual work without replacing their ERP.

Stuut is already trusted by finance teams at companies including Honeywell, NCR and ZoomInfo, from Fortune 10 enterprises to scaling mid-market businesses. We are backed by a16z, Khosla Ventures, Activant, 1984 Ventures, Page One and Microsoft.





ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a People Operations Manager to help build and run the people systems that allow Stuut to scale.



This is a foundational People role. You’ll own the core operating infrastructure across the employee lifecycle: onboarding, performance management, employee data, people systems, compliance, documentation, manager support, and employee experience. You will bring structure to a fast-moving environment without slowing the company down.



This is a great fit for someone who has operated in a high-growth startup, knows what strong People Operations looks like, and is excited to build practical, scalable processes from the ground up. You should be comfortable moving between strategy and execution — writing the policy, fixing the workflow, coaching the manager, updating the HRIS, and improving the process for next time.



You’ll work closely with Finance, Legal, Recruiting, Leadership, and managers across the company.




WHAT YOU’LL OWN


PEOPLE PROGRAMS & EMPLOYEE LIFECYCLE

 - Own and improve the employee lifecycle from onboarding through offboarding.

 - Build a high-quality onboarding experience that gives new hires clarity, context, and momentum from day one.

 - Manage employee changes including promotions, role changes, manager changes, compensation updates, leaves, and exits.

 - Create clear workflows and documentation so people processes are consistent, scalable, and easy to follow.

 - Identify gaps in current People Operations processes and implement simple systems that improve execution.


PERFORMANCE, FEEDBACK & MANAGER SUPPORT

 - Design, launch, and manage performance review cycles, including timelines, communications, templates, calibration support, and completion tracking.

 - Support compensation and promotion cycle logistics, including tracking, documentation, and process coordination.

 - Partner with managers on performance conversations, feedback, employee relations, and day-to-day people management questions.

 - Build manager resources, templates, and playbooks that help managers operate with consistency and high judgment.

 - Help create a culture where expectations are clear, feedback is direct, and strong performance is recognized.


PEOPLE SYSTEMS, DATA & OPERATIONS

 - Own and maintain our HR systems, employee records, workflows, and people data.

 - Build the reporting layer for People Operations, including headcount tracking, onboarding status, review completion, employee changes, and other key people metrics.

 - Improve systems hygiene across HRIS, payroll, benefits, documentation, and employee records.

 - Use automation and AI tools to reduce manual work and make the People function more effective.

 - Partner with Finance and Leadership on headcount planning, organizational changes, and operating cadence.


BENEFITS, COMPLIANCE & DOCUMENTATION

 - Manage benefits administration and partner with our PEO, brokers, payroll providers, legal counsel, and other external partners as needed.

 - Help ensure Stuut’s people processes are compliant, well-documented, and scalable across states and growth stages.

 - Own employment documentation, policy administration, employee handbook updates, and recurring compliance workflows.

 - Handle sensitive employee information with discretion, professionalism, and sound judgment.

 - Escalate complex issues appropriately while independently solving the things that should not require escalation.


CULTURE, COMMUNICATION & EMPLOYEE EXPERIENCE

 - Help build the rituals, resources, and programs that make Stuut a high-trust, high-performance workplace.

 - Own employee communications for People programs, including onboarding, reviews, benefits, policy changes, and engagement initiatives.

 - Maintain employee guides, internal People resources, and documentation.

 - Support employee engagement and connection programs that are meaningful, lightweight, and aligned with how Stuut works.

 - Help the company preserve speed, ownership, and talent density as we scale.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong experience building and running core People processes such as onboarding, performance reviews, manager workflows, employee changes, benefits, compliance, and documentation.

 - Experience owning HR systems and workflows; experience with Rippling or a PEO environment is strongly preferred.

 - Strong project management skills and the ability to drive multi-stakeholder processes end-to-end.

 - Excellent judgment, discretion, and professionalism when handling sensitive employee matters.

 - Strong written communication skills; you can write a clear policy, manager guide, employee memo, or process doc without needing heavy editing.

 - Analytical and systems-oriented; you are comfortable with spreadsheets, HRIS data, dashboards, and operational reporting.

 - Practical builder mindset; you know how to introduce structure without creating bureaucracy.

 - High emotional intelligence and the ability to build trust with employees, managers, and executives.

 - Bias toward action; you solve problems, find answers, and keep moving even when the process is not yet fully defined.




WHO YOU ARE

 - You are an owner. You take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks.

 - You are organized and detail-oriented, but you do not confuse process with progress.

 - You are comfortable in ambiguity and can turn messy problems into clear next steps.

 - You have high standards and care about building a company where excellent people can do the best work of their careers.

 - You communicate directly, thoughtfully, and with good judgment.

 - You are excited by AI and curious about how People teams can use AI to operate at a higher level.

 - You want to be close to the company-building work, not tucked away in a back-office function.

 - You are low ego, high intensity, and energized by working with ambitious teammates.




WHY JOIN STUUT?

 - Category-defining opportunity: We are building AI agents for one of the most important workflows in finance — getting companies paid.

 - Real ownership: This is a foundational People role with meaningful surface area from day one.

 - High-caliber team: You’ll work with sharp, ambitious people who care deeply about speed, quality, and impact.

 - Enterprise AI at the frontier: We are applying AI to complex, high-value financial workflows where accuracy, trust, and execution matter.

 - Company-building role: You’ll help shape the operating system for how Stuut hires, develops, supports, and retains great people.

 - Direct leadership exposure: You’ll partner closely with executives and managers as the company scales.

 - Real upside: You’ll join early enough to help build the foundation and benefit from the value created.




LOCATION

New York City or San Francisco. This is an in-person role.

Compensation

 - Top-of-market salary and equity package

 - Benefits (for U.S.-based full-time employees)

 - Medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you

 - 401(k) & Match

 - Equity

 - Flexible PTO

 - Parental Leave

Stuut is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a team with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the application and interview process. If you need any accommodations, please do not hesitate to reach out.

jobs.description:
Stuut is transforming how B2B companies turn revenue into cash. Businesses worldwide have trillions tied up in receivables, yet the work between order and payment still relies on fragmented systems and labor-intensive manual processes. Stuut’s AI agent works across order management, credit, collections, payments, cash application, disputes and deductions, carrying context through every step. Customers reduce DSO by 47%, collect 40% more cash and eliminate 70% of manual work without replacing their ERP.

Stuut is already trusted by finance teams at companies including Honeywell, NCR and ZoomInfo, from Fortune 10 enterprises to scaling mid-market businesses. We are backed by a16z, Khosla Ventures, Activant, 1984 Ventures, Page One and Microsoft.

The Customer Success Director will own a book of accounts post-sale through renewal and expansion. You are the primary relationship owner: driving adoption, protecting retention, and finding expansion paths tied to the customer's AR outcomes (DSO reduction, cash application accuracy, dispute cycle time)




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own onboarding through steady-state for an assigned account portfolio.

 - Drive product adoption against each customer's stated business outcomes, not feature checklists.

 - Run QBRs: outcomes delivered, ROI, expansion opportunities.

 - Own renewal forecasting and GRR for your book; flag churn risk early with a clear reason and remediation plan.

 - Identify and pursue expansion (upsell, cross-sell across Stuut products) in partnership with Sales.

 - Escalate technical or implementation issues to FDE/Support with clear context; stay accountable for resolution from the customer's side.

 - Maintain accurate account health data in Vitally.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - GRR and NRR targets met for your book (org target: NRR >110%).

 - Onboarding velocity and time-to-value hit target.

 - Clean, current account records; no surprises in forecast.


REQUIREMENTS

 - 4+ years in Customer Success or Account Management at a B2B SaaS company, ideally fintech or finance-workflow software.

 - Track record owning renewal/expansion numbers, not just satisfaction scores.

 - Comfortable with ambiguity: this is a growth-stage company building CS process as it scales.

 - Financial/AR domain fluency a plus, not required.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable running exec-level QBRs.

 - Top-of-market salary and equity package

jobs.title: Partner Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Stuut is transforming how B2B companies turn revenue into cash. Businesses worldwide have trillions tied up in receivables, yet the work between order and payment still relies on fragmented systems and labor-intensive manual processes. Stuut’s AI agent works across order management, credit, collections, payments, cash application, disputes and deductions, carrying context through every step. Customers reduce DSO by 47%, collect 40% more cash and eliminate 70% of manual work without replacing their ERP.

Stuut is already trusted by finance teams at companies including Honeywell, NCR and ZoomInfo, from Fortune 10 enterprises to scaling mid-market businesses. We are backed by a16z, Khosla Ventures, Activant, 1984 Ventures, Page One and Microsoft.


THE ROLE

Partnerships are one of Stuut's biggest growth channels, and we're hiring the person who owns the marketing behind them. As our first Partner Marketing Manager, you'll build Stuut's partner marketing motion from the ground up. You'll turn a fast-growing ecosystem of private equity sponsors and operating partners, resellers like Fiserv and Genpact, Big 4 consulting and advisory firms like EY, and hyperscaler, technology, and data-cloud partners (AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Snowflake, ServiceNow) into a repeatable, measurable source of pipeline.

This role goes well beyond managing a partner logo wall. You'll report to the Head of Marketing and work closely with our partnership leads across private equity, consulting, and reseller channels, and with Sales. You'll be the marketing counterpart they rely on to equip firms with the narrative, materials, and enablement to win deals, and the link between Stuut, our partners' marketing and field teams, and our own GTM engine. You'll translate what our AI agent does into a joint story that resonates with CFOs, PE operating partners, consulting principals, and AR leaders, and package it so both sales forces can sell it.

You'll run the partner marketing GTM playbook end to end: standing up joint value-prop docs and co-branded collateral, activating partner programs (Snowflake Partner Network tiers, Snowflake Marketplace, Microsoft Pegasus), securing and spending marketing development funds, and orchestrating joint webinars, events, and announcements. You'll set direction and ship the work, writing strategy one hour and a co-sell battlecard the next.

What success looks like: within a year, every priority partner has a sharp joint story, an activated program, and a pipeline number attached to it, and reps on both sides reach for your materials by default.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own partner co-marketing across every channel. Build the joint value proposition, messaging, and campaign plan for each priority partner: private equity sponsors and operating partners, resellers (Fiserv, Genpact), Big 4 consulting and advisory firms (EY and peers), and hyperscaler, technology, and data-cloud partners (AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Snowflake, ServiceNow, Skyflow, ZoomInfo, Microsoft Pegasus / M12).

 - Arm the private equity and portfolio motion. Build the executive briefings, portfolio learning-session content, and portfolio-level proof points and case studies that help sponsors and operating partners drive Stuut adoption across their portfolio companies.

 - Enable consulting and advisory partners. Equip Big 4 and boutique firms across referral, co-sell, and white-label motions with finance and order-to-cash transformation narratives, co-branded materials, and field enablement so they win and influence deals.

 - Own the hyperscaler marketplace motion. Stand up, optimize, and rank Stuut's listings across the hyperscaler and technology marketplaces (AWS Marketplace, Google Cloud Marketplace, Azure Marketplace, Snowflake Marketplace, ServiceNow Store), since the marketplace motion is a large part of this role. Drive co-sell registration, private offers, and marketplace-sourced pipeline through each.

 - Build the co-branded asset kit. Joint value-prop one-pagers, architecture diagrams, solution briefs, co-branded decks and sales sheets, blog and announcement content, partner web pages, and marketplace listings across the hyperscaler and technology marketplaces (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Snowflake, ServiceNow), including a "Powered by Snowflake" badge within brand guidelines.

 - Run joint campaigns and events. Plan and execute joint demand-gen campaigns, co-hosted webinars, and partner events; secure and manage partner marketing and development funds (MDF/PDF) and report on their return.

 - Activate and level up partner programs. Complete Partner Activate / SPN readiness deliverables, certify and enable partner sellers on the Stuut story, and drive tier advancement through the program tiers (Select, Premier, Elite) to unlock co-marketing budget, co-sell incentives, and partner field access.

 - Enable both sales teams to co-sell. Joint battlecards, co-sell talk tracks, joint training sessions, and account-mapping motions (such as Crossbeam) that surface and progress joint pipeline.

 - Keep co-marketing aligned to the partnership roadmap. Partner closely with our Private Equity, Consulting, and Reseller partnership leads and Sales (PE sponsors and operating partners, Fiserv reseller, Genpact reseller + MSA, EY / Big 4 consulting, the hyperscalers, Snowflake SPN, ServiceNow, Microsoft Pegasus) and keep joint pipeline moving.

 - Own partner announcements end to end. Press releases, launch content, and analyst-facing materials for major milestones, fully enabled for both field teams within a few days of go-live.

 - Own the metrics. Track and report partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, revenue, and partner NPS, and hold the quality bar for every co-branded asset across partners, contractors, agencies, and AI-assisted workflows.




YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU...

 - Have 3 to 5 or more years in B2B SaaS marketing, with meaningful time in partner, channel, alliance, or field marketing at high-growth companies selling to finance, operations, or enterprise buyers.

 - Have run co-marketing with private equity, consulting/advisory, reseller, technology/ISV, or SI partners, and can point to joint campaigns, launches, or programs that generated real, partner-sourced pipeline.

 - Have spent time inside or close to the PE, consulting, or advisory world. Working at or alongside a PE firm, a Big 4 or strategy consultancy, or an advisory-heavy partner is a strong plus, because you already understand how those firms think, buy, and sell.

 - Know how the hyperscaler marketplaces actually work (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure) along with Snowflake Marketplace and the ServiceNow Store: listings, private offers, co-sell registration, and marketplace-sourced pipeline.

 - Understand how partner programs actually work: MDF/co-op funds, marketplace listings, co-sell motions, deal registration, account mapping (Crossbeam/Reveal), and tiering.

 - Understand enterprise sales cycles, complex buying committees, and what content moves a $100K+ deal forward for both your reps and your partners' reps.

 - Write with clarity and conviction, and can turn a dense technical integration into a joint story a CFO would actually read.

 - Are comfortable with ambiguity and building from zero. This is a first partner-marketing hire with a blank canvas.

 - Are fluent with AI-powered tools for research, content creation, and workflow acceleration. You use Claude, ChatGPT, or similar to produce strong first drafts and move faster.




THIS PROBABLY ISN'T A FIT IF...

 - You've spent the majority of your career at companies with 500+ employees.

 - Your idea of partner marketing is coordinating a logo swap and a quarterly newsletter. We need someone who builds programs that generate pipeline.




HOW WE WORK AT STUUT

Stuut marketing runs on four pillars: take big swings, revenue is all that matters, learn fast through quantitative rigor, and stay product-first. We're a lean team that ships. You'll have unusual ownership, real budget, and direct exposure to the founders and to our partners' senior marketing and field teams. If you want to do the best work of your career and see it show up in pipeline, this is the team to do it with.

A note on AI: We treat AI as a genuine collaborator. We expect you to use it to think better and ship faster, and to make your work easy for the rest of the team to build on.

 - Top-of-market salary and equity package

 - Benefits (for U.S.-based full-time employees)

 - Medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you

 - 401(k) & Match

 - Equity

 - Flexible PTO

 - Parental Leave
